evidence_status: posthoc frozen-rule transfer replay on already used Phase-A targets; it cannot serve as independent confirmation or change the Stage102B NO-GO.

frozen_rule.stable_redundancy: R_ij=max(0,min_seed PearsonCorr(train-fitted receptor rank profiles)); only positive redundancy observed in every seed is penalized.
frozen_rule.quality_floor: For fixed k, mean singleton utility must be at least pair-off top-k mean singleton utility minus 0.5 times the root-sum-square jackknife singleton spread divided by k.
frozen_rule.solver: SciPy HiGHS MILP, exact pair-product linearization, zero requested MIP gap, 60 second time limit.
frozen_rule.rule_frozen_from: Stage68 selected_candidate uncertainty_0p5x; no coefficient, aggregation, threshold, fold, or subset-size tuning is permitted here.

decision.next_action: Use the replay only to judge whether the Stage68 constrained-selection application transfers to these contrasting targets. Do not alter the frozen rule or claim independent efficacy from this posthoc replay.
